description: Saves a voice to the person's voices (or removes it with saved false), so it shows first in the voice picker in every later chat and in Fuzzframe's own voice list. The picker's star does this by itself; call it when they ask you to save or forget a voice. Free.

about.description: The voice's one-line description from the voices tool

name.description: The voice's name, as the voices tool lists it

saved.description: false removes it from their voices
